description: [Merchant] Get the status of an asynchronous report generation request. Use this to monitor report progress.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses production private key as default (Data API is production-only).

requestId.description: The request ID returned from the report generation request (UUID format)

name: payware_data_get_report_status
